dedupe_keys.name: daily electricity demand data for indian states 2014 2024

description: This data set gives daily electricity demand for each Indian state from 2014 to 2024, paired with weather variables, to support data-driven demand modelling. It was published on Zenodo in March 2025 by Kieran Hunt and Hannah Bloomfield, with methods in their paper on building and explaining data-driven energy demand models for Indian states. The demand data were scraped from India's national grid reports and give, per state and day, the energy met in million units (GWh), the peak power met in MW, and the peak unmet demand in MW, which measures shortage. Quality-controlled versions that correct transcription errors are provided and recommended. Each state file also holds daily minimum, mean and maximum 2 m temperature, 10 m winds, 2 m dew point, surface solar radiation, total cloud cover and the Universal Thermal Climate Index, for training machine learning models. Coverage is India's states and union territories. Files are CSV, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: data are scraped from reports, not from an official series, and state boundaries changed during the period. Simulation uses are weather-sensitive demand forecasting, heat-driven peak demand analysis and supply shortfall studies. Related records: data-india-power-supply-position-daily-reports is the grid operator source.
